# The core rules

Every core rule lives in `src/domain`: pure functions, with no database, screen or network code. The app, the import, the reviews and the AI assistant all call the same ones. Read them in this order; each builds on the ones before.

| Rule | What it decides |
|---|---|
| [Weeks and plans](weeks-and-plans.md) | Which week it is, and what a goal’s plan says its number should be in any week. |
| [A goal’s status](status.md) | What the numbers say (the calculated status), and the official status everyone sees: the owner’s call, unless it has gone stale. |
| [The projection](projection.md) | Where a number lands by its due week if the recent trend holds: the likeliest value and a range around it. |
| [What a check-in must say](check-in.md) | What a check-in needs before it can be posted, and the record it becomes. |
| [Numbers and names](numbers-and-names.md) | How a typed number is kept and shown, which numbers are questioned, and how two goals or two people with the same name are told apart. |
| [Flags, the trend and needs attention](flags.md) | Why a goal is flagged, which way it is heading, and whether it needs attention or is being handled. |
| [The scorecard](scorecard.md) | The cells at the top of a goal’s page: against plan, since last week, what’s left, and how likely it is to hit the target. |
| [The change engine](change-engine.md) | The one way many changes come in at once: a spreadsheet, set-up, the bulk check-in grid, the data tables and MCP. |
| [Deciding in a review](review-decide.md) | A goal behind leaves a review with a next step (an owner and a week) or an accepted risk with a reason; the next session opens with what the last one agreed. |
| [The workspace: cycles, teams, names, leaving and what needs attention](workspace.md) | What Workspace says about each cycle and team, the longest name a workspace may have, who may leave, and what its overview lists as needing attention. |
| [The directory: who People lists, what a search finds, and where old addresses lead](directory.md) | People’s order and search, a page at a time; the line beside a person; a team’s people and goals by status; and where People’s and Teams’ old Workspace addresses now lead. |
| [The goal map](map.md) | The critical path, what the map shows when folded, what a parent says about the goals under it, which trees are in trouble, and finding a goal by name or key. |
| [Finding things](finding.md) | What a search matches, the near miss offered when nothing does, and the one search per kind of thing (goals, people, teams) that every list, picker and Find calls. |
| [Navigation: the menu, the lit item and a page’s name](navigation.md) | Which places the menu lists for a viewer, where a module’s items go, which one is lit at an address, what a page is called, and what a Back link says. |

## The numbers the rules turn on

From `src/domain/thresholds.ts`:

| Name | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `RULES.onTrack` | 0.95 | Share of the planned change for on track |
| `RULES.atRisk` | 0.8 | Share of the planned change for at risk (below it is off track) |
| `RULES.wellAhead` | 1.2 | Share of the planned change for well ahead (still on track; asks why) |
| `RULES.staleDays` | 14 | Days without a check-in before a goal has no recent update |
| `RULES.lateWeeksOff` | 2 | Weeks late beyond which a stage is off track |
| `TREND_SPAN` | 3 | Check-ins the trend looks back over |
